title: feat(app-shell): the hosted marketplace install offers and sends the install mode a package permits
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoVXP4s3MFTrPqUtxatiSwyk)_

Fixes #30963

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:托管云环境里的应用市场详情页,现在也会读取包声明的 `installModes`;包允许 unmanaged 时显示与本地安装页相同的「安装模式」选择,并把所选模式作为 `install_mode` 发给 `/api/v1/cloud-connection/install`。只允许 managed 或未声明的包,请求与以前逐字节相同。
- 为什么改:cloud#3624 裁决 A(一个安装入口,`installMode` 作为可选参数由控制面裁决)。此前托管路径无法表达模式,为「被拥有」而做的起步模板在托管云上只能装成 managed。
- 风险与回滚:仅 Console 代码(`@object-ui/app-shell` patch)。环境侧转发(#30964)落地前,该参数在下游被忽略;此时页面会明确提示「已按 managed 安装」,不会假装成功复制。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 的 `hostedInstallMode` 与 `doInstall` 答复分支;`marketplaceApi.ts` 的 `installPackage()`;测试文件新增的两个 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installMode-12288.test.tsx`,预期 32/32 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ui 席 2 对照 head `374cdc9c` 的 diff 复核：4 个文件、+278 / −43，无受治理路径。托管安装 `installPackage()` 新增可选 `installMode`（取自 spec 的 `INSTALL_MODES`），只在设定时发送 `install_mode`；只允许托管或未声明安装方式的包，请求体逐字节不变（有断言）。环境控制台（有云端地址）的包页用与本地安装同一解析读取 `installModes`，画同一选择；两个安装入口共用一个拒绝文案函数。#30964（服务端）落地前，选择「非托管副本」会按托管安装并如实提示；控制面自身控制台不画选择，因副本只能由环境内的 cloud-connection 安装路由生成，理由写在 Acceptance notes。CI 59 项全绿，Clause-② no，不欠契约复审。同意落地。

## What changes

- **`installPackage()`** (`marketplaceApi.ts`) takes an optional `installMode`, typed from the spec's `INSTALL_MODES` (`LocalInstallMode` is now the spec's `InstallMode`, and the console's mode list is `INSTALL_MODES` itself, so a mode the spec adds reaches the page without a second list). It is sent as `install_mode` only when set: on the hosted route `POST /api/v1/cloud-connection/install` as a top-level body key, and on the control plane's own `install_package` action inside `params`. Unset, neither body gains a key.
- **Wire key `install_mode`.** The cloud-connection install route reads its body in snake case (`package_id`, `seed_sample_data`, with camel-case fallbacks), and it forwards to the control plane's `install_package` action, whose `params` are snake case too. The route does not read the key yet: that is #30964 (`pm:blocked`), which forwards the mode.
- **The package page on the hosted path** (a cloud base, no install-local door) reads the manifest the marketplace serves (`GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages/:id/versions/latest/manifest`, proxied on hosted) and resolves it through `declaredInstallModesOf`, the install-local page's resolver; no second reading. The same choice element is drawn: both modes ⇒ the radio choice and Install waits for a pick; `unmanaged` alone ⇒ the "this install is a copy" note and `unmanaged` is sent. A package that declares no `installModes`, permits only `managed`, or whose manifest cannot be read sends no mode. An update of an installed copy sends no mode and draws no choice.
- **The answer** is read as install-local reads its own: `installMode: 'unmanaged'` ⇒ the success sentence names the base and the CTA does not flip to Installed (the copy is not a package installation, per the ruling's acceptance note). A requested copy answered without it ⇒ the existing "installed managed instead" sentence (`marketplace.install.unmanagedIgnored`), because that is what an environment that does not forward the mode does today.
- **Refusals**: the install-local catch block's code-to-text mapping is now one helper, `installRefusalText`, used by both install doors. The hosted error now carries the envelope's `details`, so `DEPENDENCY_MISSING` is drawn from its facts there too; the install-mode refusals show the server's own message on both.
- No i18n key is added: every sentence used exists already.

## Tests

`MarketplacePackagePage.installMode-12288.test.tsx` is the shared harness for install modes (`marketplaceApi` not mocked, one stubbed `fetch` answering by path), so the new pins are two top-level `describe` blocks there:

- the hosted path: both modes draw the choice and gate Install; each picked mode is sent; `unmanaged` alone is sent with the copy note; no `installModes`, `managed` only and an unreadable manifest each send a body with no `install_mode` key (`not.toHaveProperty`); the unmanaged and ignored answers; two install-mode refusals; `DEPENDENCY_MISSING` drawn from its facts.
- `installPackage()` on both branches: absent sends no key, set sends it.
- The list page's one-click install keeps its pinned body: `MarketplacePage.disabledInstall-28521.test.tsx` asserts `[{ package_id: 'pkg_1', seed_sample_data: true }]` on `POST /api/v1/cloud-connection/install`, unchanged and green.

## Acceptance notes

- **End to end needs #30964.** Until the environment's `CloudConnectionPlugin` forwards `install_mode`, a hosted request for a copy installs managed, and the page shows `marketplace.install.unmanagedIgnored` ("installed managed instead"). That is the truthful outcome until then. The proof here is unit and harness readings (below); no live hosted install was run.
- **Answer shape assumed for the hosted copy.** The page recognises an unmanaged hosted install by `installMode: 'unmanaged'` on the answer, the field install-local answers with (with `targetPackageId` and `version`). #30964 defines the hosted answer; if it answers another shape, the page reads it as "installed managed instead", loudly, not as success. The install-local answer's `strippedLocks` list is not drawn on the hosted path yet.
- **The choice is drawn only where a cloud base is set** (an environment console on hosted cloud), not on the control plane's own console, because no copy can happen there: per #30964 the unmanaged copy is run by the environment's `CloudConnectionPlugin` (`importUnmanagedPackage` in the environment) on its own install route, and the control-plane console's install goes straight to the `install_package` action, never through that environment. Its sentences would also be false there: the mode hint and success text say "this runtime", while that dialog targets another environment. `installPackage()` still sends a given mode on that branch, so the parameter is never silently dropped.
- **Sample data with an unmanaged pick.** The hosted dialog still offers "Include sample data" when `unmanaged` is picked; per #30964 an unmanaged grant loads no sample data. Not changed here, since what the control plane does with the flag on a copy is #30964's and cloud's.
- **Not a bug, per the ruling:** an unmanaged copy does not appear in the marketplace "Installed" list (it reads `sys_package_installation`); no code was added for it.
- Lint: `eslint` on the three files reports 0 errors; warnings 52 → 53 on the two source files, the one new `no-explicit-any` being `(err as any).details`, the same spelling install-local's error already uses.

## Verification

All readings on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, head `374cdc9c` (base `1b3e22f0`).

<details><summary>Before / after: hosted harness reading (cloud base set, install-local off)</summary>

A throwaway probe (not committed) rendered the page with three manifests, picked `unmanaged` when a choice was drawn, and installed through the dialog.

Before, page code at `1b3e22f0`:

```
READING both: manifestRead=false radios=0 installDisabledBeforePick=false picked=none body={"package_id":"pkg_crm","seed_sample_data":false}
READING managed-only: manifestRead=false radios=0 installDisabledBeforePick=false picked=none body={"package_id":"pkg_crm","seed_sample_data":false}
READING absent: manifestRead=false radios=0 installDisabledBeforePick=false picked=none body={"package_id":"pkg_crm","seed_sample_data":false}
```

After:

```
READING both: manifestRead=true radios=2 installDisabledBeforePick=true picked=unmanaged body={"package_id":"pkg_crm","seed_sample_data":false,"install_mode":"unmanaged"}
READING managed-only: manifestRead=true radios=0 installDisabledBeforePick=false picked=none body={"package_id":"pkg_crm","seed_sample_data":false}
READING absent: manifestRead=true radios=0 installDisabledBeforePick=false picked=none body={"package_id":"pkg_crm","seed_sample_data":false}
```

The new pins against the base page code: 14 failed, 18 passed (32). With the fix: 32 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (each mutation landed via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- A: `hostedInstallMode` never takes the resolved mode ⇒ 4 failed (both picked modes, `unmanaged` alone, the ignored answer).
- B: the `managed`-only guard removed ⇒ 1 failed: "a manifest that permits `managed` only draws no choice, and the request carries no `install_mode` key".
- C: the hosted catch shows the bare message instead of `installRefusalText` ⇒ 1 failed: the `DEPENDENCY_MISSING` pin.

The subject resolves from source (relative imports), so no dist build was owed.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests and gates</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/` (under the verify lock): Test Files 55 passed (55), Tests 485 passed (485).
- `cd ui/packages/app-shell && pnpm run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, after a full dts build of `@object-ui/app-shell^...`, under the verify lock): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Derived gates, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head `374cdc9c`: 36 commands, each run with stdin closed, every one `:: exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: "36 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The list includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)".
- `eslint` on the three changed files: 0 errors.
</details>
